title: Devops Engineer
description:
Description
We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer to join the infrastructure team to build and maintain the infrastructure that powers reliable product delivery at scale. You will help ensure that engineering teams can ship faster, systems stay stable, and customers receive a seamless experience.
In this role, you will own and improve the platforms, automation, and processes behind our development lifecycle - from deployment pipelines and infrastructure reliability to monitoring and operational excellence. Your will work closely with client team and impact for delivering new features and how confidently we can run our products in production.
We are actively integrating AI and automation into all areas of the business and are looking for candidates with a mindset focused on improving efficiency, automating repetitive processes, and delivering a better user experience.
Key responsibilities

• Own and operate CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and the self-hosted runner fleet (Linux/macOS/Windows); keep deploys and rollbacks reliable and fast.

• Operate Kubernetes (Hetzner) and Helm-managed services; containerize and ship services with Docker.

• Operate and recover the data layer: MySQL/Percona XtraDB (multi-region replication), ClickHouse, Redis/Memcached, Kafka.

• Own the network/edge layer: nginx load balancing, Cloudflare/CDN, DNS, TLS certificates.

• Maintain the observability stack (self-hosted Sentry, Prometheus/Grafana, Graylog) and run its migrations.

• Maintain build infrastructure for mobile/desktop apps

• Serve as infrastructure on-call: incident response, coordination, and root-cause analysis.

• Use AI tooling to accelerate configuration, automation, diagnostics, and documentation.

Requirements

• Production CI/CD: Jenkins + GitHub Actions.

• Kubernetes + Helm; Docker.

• Strong Linux administration; nginx; operating PHP/php-fpm applications.

• MySQL/Percona XtraDB: replication, recovery, troubleshooting.

• Configuration management with Ansible.

• Scripting: Bash + (Python or PHP).

• CDN/Cloudflare or other S3-compatible storage experience.

• MacOS/iOS builds (fastlane, certificates, provisioning, DSYM), Android builds.

• Nexus or other private registries.

• On-call / incident-management experience.

• Practical, daily use of AI coding/ops assistants.

Nice to have

• ClickHouse, Redis/Memcached, Kafka, ZooKeeper.

• Self-hosted Sentry, Prometheus/Grafana, DataDog

• Multi-region infrastructure; Go (for tooling/exporters)

This means understanding distinct audience needs, identifying promising use cases, and turning evidence into a clear product strategy. Your work will connect discovery and early product development with adoption, retention, and sustained user value.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is launching payments across the EU through its Swedish payment institution. Our European operations team (Europs) onboards European businesses and keeps them trading, across Ramp's own regulated entities and our card-issuing and payments partners. We're a small team that runs on frontier AI tooling: our operators build and use their own automations so they can spend their time on judgement, not admin. We're hiring a KYB/AML Analyst in Stockholm to review and onboard business customers of our Swedish entity, work directly with those customers to get them live, and resolve onboarding requirements raised by our partners. You'll join a small Swedish team and help keep onboarding moving every day as we grow.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Carry out first-line (1LoD) KYB reviews of business customers onboarding with Ramp's Swedish payment institution: company verification, beneficial ownership, sanctions/PEP/adverse-media screening, and risk assessment

- Decide standard cases end to end, and escalate complex or higher-risk cases with a clear rationale

- Handle customer communications through onboarding: clear document requests, follow-ups and status updates

- Resolve onboarding requirements from our card-issuing and payments partners for EU customers

- Document decisions to a standard that holds up to second-line and regulatory review

- Keep Swedish casework moving when teammates are on leave or handling incidents

- Spend part of your time improving how we work: playbooks, templates and AI-assisted workflows

WHAT YOU NEED

- 2-4 years of KYB / AML / onboarding experience at a fintech, payment institution, EMI or bank

- Solid grounding in business customer due diligence: company registers, UBO identification, sanctions/PEP screening, and spotting red flags

- Fluent English, written and verbal

- Clear, friendly written communication with customers

- Curiosity about AI tools and how they can make casework faster and better

- Based in, or relocating to, Stockholm, with the right to work in Sweden

title: People Partner GTM
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're scaling from 1,000 → 4,000 employees across 50+ countries, and the complexity of our teams, hubs, and workflows is growing quickly. Our People Partners play a critical role in enabling leads, supporting peeps, and protecting performance and culture as we grow. As a People Partner at ElevenLabs, you'll sit at the intersection of leadership coaching, organisational design, performance, and day-to-day people guidance.

You'll be the dedicated People Partner for our entire Revenue organisation across North America and LATAM, working closely with the Revenue leadership team to understand their rhythms, challenges, and talent needs deeply. You'll meet proactively with leads and teams, unblock people issues, and help architect the organisation ahead of scale, with Employee Relations and employment counsel on hand when cases need them.

This is a high-impact role for someone who can context-switch quickly, advise with confidence, build trust across functions, and bring clarity and calm to fast-moving environments.

YOU WILL

- Act as the dedicated People Partner for Revenue across North America and LATAM, owning the people agenda for the organisation end to end.

- Partner deeply with the Revenue leadership team to improve team health, performance, talent density, and organizational clarity.

- Run proactive 1:1 sessions

title: Senior Clinical Research Associate
description:
JOB SUMMARY
The Senior Clinical Research Associate is responsible for the site management, site monitoring and close-out of assigned clinical trials investigator sites to ensure patient safety and quality study execution in accordance with applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards.
The Senior Clinical Research Associate role is accountable for site management and monitoring, managing investigator site relationships to ensure effective delivery of clinical trials (e.g. enrollment, database release), to safeguard the quality of investigator sites (e.g. patient safety, site quality and compliance with GCP), to maintain investigator and site staff engagement and satisfaction, and to enhance the company’s image with its external stakeholders.
The Senior Clinical Research Associate is responsible for the resolution of all protocol-related issues for assigned investigator sites and will work closely with the Site Care Partner, and other members of the study team, as required, in activities associated with the set-up, running and close out of sites in a clinical trial.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
Responsible for investigator site management and monitoring for assigned sites:
Clinical Trial Monitoring:

• Ensure proper conduct of clinical trials in accordance with the Study Monitoring Plan and applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards to achieve project goals, timelines and quality

• Manage assigned operational aspects for implementation of clinical trial activities at assigned investigator sites from site initiation through to database lock, ensuring relevant timelines and quality deliverables are met

• During study conduct, serve as the primary point of contact for assigned investigator sites. Work in partnership with and/or escalate to the SCP to ensure quality of site delivery

• Interface with the study team as needed, facilitate information flow between members of the study team, vendors and assigned investigator sites

• Partner with SCP to perform investigator site development, coaching and training of site personnel to ensure ongoing compliance with protocol and the safeguarding of patients; provide protocol training to, and address protocol related questions from the investigator site staff when required, including discussions on known/anticipated operational and clinical trial risks

• Attend investigator meetings when required (virtual or F2F).

• Provide enrollment support and ensure progress by responding to site activation and recruitment issues from investigators. Partner with SCP and the study team to define and support recruitment initiatives at site level

• Conduct onsite, remote/electronic monitoring as needed for study site initiation, routine monitoring and study site closure activities and ensure these are conducted accordance to the Study Monitoring Plan, SOPs and commensurate with emerging issues and technologies.

• Monitor site level AEs and SAEs and collaborate with the Drug Safety Unit and follow-up with investigators sites, as needed, to bring SAE reports required information to resolution

• Submit all required reports, documentation, updates and tracking within required timeframes, including but not limited to Trial Master File documentation, site reports, site follow up letters, protocol deviations, patient recruitment, clinical supply management, study progress and metrics

• Identify and resolve investigator site issues within required timeframes; agree and develop corrective and preventative actions with investigator and site personnel to close open issues and to prevent recurrence/persistence of issues

• Resolve data queries within required timelines, prepare investigator site close-out plan and conduct close-out activities within required timelines

• Ensures adequate oversight of the investigational product at the investigator site, including receipt, handling, accounting, storage conditions, and destruction activities.

• Support databa

title: Autonomy Integration Engineer (Drone Stack)
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Autonomy Integration Engineer within our Drone Stack team at Applied Intuition, you will serve as the technical anchor bridging hardware, edge software, and field flight operations. Split roughly 50/50 between the lab and the airfield, you will be responsible for bringing autonomous aerial systems from initial benchtop configuration to live operational flight.

In this role, you will configure embedded Linux environments, deploy and validate containerized software stacks, wire up mesh network topologies, and write key middleware glue code to keep subsystems communicating seamlessly. You are as comfortable with a soldering iron and oscilloscope at the bench as you are SSH-ing into an onboard computer over a mesh radio under field conditions.

This opportunity can also be located at our Drone Lab near Fort Walton Beach, Florida or HQ in Sunnyvale, CA (relocation offered).

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead System Bring-Up: Drive end-to-end hardware and software integration for unmanned aerial systems, moving platforms from benchtop prototyping to active flight test campaigns.

- Deploy & Configure Edge Software: Manage, configure, and deploy software stacks using Docker images, shell scripts, and Linux system tools across onboard computes and peripheral hardware.

- Field & Bench Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot vehicle networks, payload interfaces, and sensor links in real time using command-line tools (grep, less, journalctl, nano/vim) and hardware diagnostics (multimeters, oscilloscopes).

- Build Test Tooling & Glue Code: Develop Python and C++ scripts for data reduction, log analysis, system validation, and real-time subsystem verification.

- System Cabling & Electronics: Fabricate custom wiring harnesses, perform precision soldering, and define system-level architecture using clear block diagrams.

- Manage Communications & Networks: Configure IP routing, subnets, and local network interfaces between flight controllers, companion computers, radios, and ground control stations.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Experience: 5+ years of experience in robotics integration, flight test engineering, embedded systems, or autonomous vehicles (aerial background preferred).

- Linux & Networking Mastery: Deep practical comfort with the Linux CLI, file management, system logging, local IP routing, subnets, and containerized deployments (Docker).

- Hardware & Electronics Capability: Proven hands-on skills in wiring, custom cable assembly, bench soldering, and physical diagnostics using oscilloscopes and multimeters.

- Scripting & Glue Code: Strong proficiency in Python, C++, or She

title: Growth Lead (Berlin)
description:
Our bar is high, and this is the best place for ambitious builders.

Bootstrapped and profitable from day one, Almedia is Germany’s fastest-growing company (FT1000). Join us as we build the global leader in rewards, at a $1bn+ revenue run rate and climbing fast.

At Almedia, you’ll:

- Own way more, way earlier - you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

- Join a rare environment - you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

GROWTH LEAD (BERLIN)

Salary: €70k-€110k

We are looking for a powerhouse Growth Lead (Berlin) to become the a dedicated leader for our Growth (sales and account management) team. Reporting directly to the Growth Director and in close alignment with the CEO, you will be the architect of our go-to-market engine. This is a dual-impact role: you will lead, coach, and motivate a high-performing team while remaining "in the trenches" to close strategic partnerships with the world’s top mobile game publishers.

 

You will own end-to-end growth by building a high-accountability team culture and a repeatable GTM playbook. You will turn publisher insights into product strategy, move fast to scale our outbound motion, and raise the bar on execution across the entire lifecycle-from first contact to long-term integration and partnership.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 🎯

- Architect the GTM Playbook: Build and own a repeatable outbound sales motion. You’ll define our segmentation, messaging, and CRM workflows to ensure the team executes with speed and precision.

- Lead from the Front: Personally drive Tier-1 deals from discovery to signed integration. You will land key accounts that serve as the "win stories" to unlock the rest of the market.

- Scale & Mentor the Team: Manage, motivate, and develop a part of the Growth team. You’ll be responsible for their KPIs, career growth plans, and day-to-day coaching to foster a culture of extreme ownership.

- Bridge Product & Market: Create a tight feedback loop with Product and Engineering. You will translate publisher needs into a prioritized backlog, ensuring our roadmap is aligned with what the market actually buys.

- Operational Excellence: Define the rituals of success-qualification standards, pipeline hygiene, and forecasting. You will provide the Growth Director with a live, transparent view of deal health and unblock the team to keep opportunities moving.

WHAT YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS LOOK LIKE

- Days 1-30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on.

- Days 31-60: Take over a full book of accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement.

- Days 61-90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book.

- Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Lead to Strategic Growth Lead with even more ownership, and beyond.

 

WHAT YOU’LL BRING 💡

- The "Player-Coach" DNA: You have a proven track record of running full-cycle enterprise sales (prospect → pitch → close) while simultaneously managing a small team.

- Pipeline Mastery: You know how to build an outbound engine from scratch. You are comfortable experimenting with A/B outreach, sequencing, and offer tests to find what sticks.

- Strategic Communication: You can translate complex product features into quantified ROI for Monetization and LiveOps leaders at major game studios.

- High-Stakes Leadership: You give candid feedback, address performance early, and know how to keep a remote or multi-geo team (Berlin/China/Israel) engaged and hungry.

- Operational Rigor: You don’t just "do sales"-you build systems. You are a power user of CRM data and live by pipeline hygiene.

description:
Job description
Job Purpose:
The CEO will have full accountability for the company's overall performance, leading sustainable and profitable growth while strengthening operational excellence, financial discipline, and organizational capability. The role requires a hands-on leader who can balance strategic direction with strong execution across the organization.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Strategy, Growth & Value Creation
Define and execute the companys short and long term strategy aligned with shareholders and Board objectives.
Identify and evaluate growth opportunities across markets, products, channels, and partnerships.
Ensure growth initiatives are financially viable, operationally scalable, and aligned with the companys brand and capabilities.
Translate strategy into clear, measurable execution plans across the organization.
2. Financial Performance & Profitability
Full accountability for company P&L, EBITDA, and Net Profit.
Drive margin improvement through pricing strategy, cost optimization, and operational efficiency.
Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance reviews with the Board.
Ensure disciplined capital allocation and return on investment for growth initiatives.
3. Operational Excellence
Set and own company-wide operational performance standards across all functions.
Ensure scalability, consistency, and resilience of operations to support.
Champion continuous improvement initiatives focused on productivity, efficiency, quality, and waste reduction.
Hold executive team accountable for operational outcomes through clear KPIs.
4. Organization, Leadership & Culture
Lead, develop, and evaluate senior leadership team across key functions.
Build a high-performance, accountable culture aligned with the companys values and strategic ambitions.
Ensure organizational readiness for growth, including structure, capabilities, and talent depth.
Drive succession planning and leadership development to ensure long-term sustainability.
5. External Leadership & Stakeholder Management
Act as the primary representative of the company with key external stakeholders, including shareholders, investors, partners, and regulators.
Strengthen the companys market positioning and reputation through effective external engagement.
6. Risk, Turnaround & Crisis Management
Anticipate and manage business risks proactively.
Demonstrate strong crisis management and turnaround capability when required.
Ensure business continuity and operational resilience across the organization.
7. Operating Environment:
The CEO will operate within a highly competitive and growth-oriented market, with full responsibility for positioning the company to achieve sustainable, profitable expansion.
The role requires ensuring that the organizations strategy, operating model, leadership capabilities, and resources are aligned to support long-term growth objectives and evolving market dynamics.
8. Communications and working Relationships:
The CEO serves as the principal point of contact with Board of Directors and is responsible for maintaining clear, structured, and transparent communication on business performance, risks, and strategic priorities.
Externally, the CEO represents the company at an executive level with key stakeholders, including strategic partners, regulators, major suppliers, and the wider business community, safeguarding the companys reputation and strategic interests.
Framework, Boundaries, Decision-Making Authority, and Responsibility:
The CEO holds boards executive authority to lead and manage the business within the strategic framework and governance policies approved by the Board.
The role is fully accountable for executive decision-making related to strategy execution, organizational effectiveness, financial performance, and overall business results, ensuring alignment with Board-approved objectives and long-term value creation.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, COMMERCIAL EXPANSION - SAN FRANCISCO

Our Commercial team focuses on high-growth companies where AI adoption is moving fast and deals are often enterprise-sized. We're hiring a Commercial Expansion Account Executive to own a book of existing accounts, deliver meaningful value to customers, drive expansion, and ensure successful renewals. This is a proactive, sales-led role focused on unlocking the next wave of growth within some of SpaceXSI's most exciting customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Own a portfolio of existing commercial customers and be accountable for expansion, net revenue retention, and renewals, landing new business units, deepening adoption, and cross-selling SpaceXSI's platform

- Target outcomes: You deliver meaningful value to customers, helping them stay ahead of the curve by growing adoption and transforming the way they build software; you consistently hit or exceed renewal and expansion targets across your book of business; your Tier 1 accounts see meaningful year-over-year growth in both usage and revenue, and you can point to specific multi-threaded plays you ran to make it happen; customers trust you as a strategic partner who can explain SpaceXSI's roadmap and pricing, and how the broader AI landscape is shifting and what that means for them; internally, Sales and Product leaders rely on you for signal on what's working (and what isn't) in our expansion and renewal playbook

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- 3+ years of closing experience in tech sales

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Meaningful expansion and renewal experience: you've owned a book of business, run renewal cycles, and can walk through how you turned an initial land into significant expansion

- Experience selling technical products, including dev tools, infrastructure, data/AI platforms, payments/fintech, or similarly complex, multi-stakeholder solutions

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager
description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance. That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users.

We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken - you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What you'll be doing

As our Senior Performance Marketing Manager, you'll take full ownership of the paid acquisition strategy for your assigned product portfolio, driving multi-channel growth and combining analytical rigour with strategic vision.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

- Product Ownership - Own performance marketing strategy and execution end-to-end for assigned products, from planning through reporting and optimisation.

- Multi-Channel Acquisition - Plan, manage, and optimise full-funnel acquisition campaigns across key platforms, including Google (SEA, UAC, YouTube), Meta, ASA, LinkedIn, and TikTok.

- B2C & B2B Strategy - Develop and execute tailored acquisition strategies across both B2C and B2B models, adapting the channel mix, messaging, and KPIs to different audiences and sales cycles.

- Mobile Marketing - Apply advanced knowledge of mobile marketing dynamics, including attribution, deep linking, and mobile measurement partners (MMPs), to drive app-first product performance.

- Data-Driven Strategy - Define and monitor KPIs, budgets, and forecasts, leveraging rigorous data analysis to guide decisions and improve results.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration - Partner closely with Product, Data, Creative/Brand, and Sales teams to align performance strategy with broader company goals.

- Stakeholder Management - Build strong relationships across the organisation, presenting results, insights, and strategic recommendations with clarity and confidence.

- Continuous Testing - Monitor market dynamics and platform evolutions, actively proposing and testing new channel opportunities.

Who we're looking for

This role needs someone with real ownership and strategic vision who treats their channels and products as their own business, proactively solving problems and driving measurable business impact.

- Experience - 5-7+ years in Performance Marketing roles with direct ownership of six-figure budgets.

- Ownership & Accountability - 100% accountability for KPIs and outcomes, identifying challenges early and independently driving solutions.

- Strategic Vision - Ability to turn long-term product and channel vision into structured roadmaps with clear hypotheses, priorities, and trade-offs.

- Critical Thinking - Proactive approach to challenging the status quo across channel mix, budget allocation, tracking, creative, and cross-team workflows.

- Autonomous Decision-Making - High comfort making decisions with incomplete information, taking responsibility for results, and learning quickly.

- Channel Expertise - Hands-on experience managing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, ASA, and Affiliation.

- Data & Analytics - Strong proficiency in interpreting complex performance metrics and translating data into actionable forecasts and strategies.

- Stakeholder Management - Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and challenge stakeholders at every level.

- B2B & B2C Exposure - Experience navigating both business models is strongly preferred.

- AI-Savvy - Genuine interest and hands-on familiarity with modern AI tools to simplify workflows and optimise campaign performance.

- Languages - Fluency in Italian and English

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.
LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.
Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

Job Description
Work at Home Bilingual Khmer -English Video-Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Khmer Interpreter
Location: Work at Home position in United States
Position: Video-Phone Interpreter
Pay: $20 - $23 per hour.

• Compensation will not be less than any applicable state or local minimum wage.

We Offer:

• Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.

• Incentives for meeting attendance targets.

• Benefits include: Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable law, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Accident, Critical Illness & Life, AD&D, Insurance Package, Inpatient Hospital, Short Term Disability, and 401K Retirement.

• Employee Referral Program.

• Advancement opportunities within the organization.

• Interpreter support.

• An inclusive and diverse work environment.

Position Overview:

The Khmer Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Khmer and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**

Essential Job Functions:

• Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.

• Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.

• Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.

• Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.

• Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.

• Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.

• Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.

• Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.

• Follow client instructions, in compliance

You have a strong interest in (generative) AI and actively experiment with the latest tools and developments. Above all, you understand that strong ideas, taste and art direction matter more than technical mastery of any individual tool.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Shape the visual and motion direction of projects from concept to delivery

• Develop strong creative ideas rooted in narrative, pacing, and visual structure

• Design and animate high quality motion work across campaigns and formats

• Define look and feel, styleframes, and motion language for projects

• Collaborate closely with designers, creatives, and other disciplines

• Guide motion execution to keep work aligned with the original creative intent

• Stay curious of new tools, references, and techniques across motion and visual design

WHAT YOU BRING:

About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. title: Principal Engineer - AV Simulation and Evaluation
description:
We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to architect and build core platform systems to accelerate Physical AI development, such as Autonomous Driving (AV) & Robotics. This is a technical role for someone with expertise at the intersection of data architecture, distributed systems, and Autonomous Vehicle development across cloud, local, and on-road environments. You will own deep technical areas end-to-end: such as AV/Robotics simulation infrastructure and AV performance evaluation.

What you will be doing:

• Design and build simulation and evaluation infrastructure used by AV and ML engineers, to accelerate development of Level 4 self-driving capabilities.

• Evolve efficient data formats for AV evaluation: designing for performance, interoperability, and correctness across formats like Protobuf, Arrow, Parquet, and MCAP.

• Collaborate with AI and Robotics teams to deeply understand their simulation and evaluation needs.

• Build reliable services, APIs, data pipelines, and AV simulation and evaluation workflows and framework that operate at the scale of hundreds of millions of runs per day.

• Optimize performance at every level: profiling, parallelization, memory efficiency, query optimization, and protocol redesign.

• Build diagnostic and observability tooling that enables teams to understand and debug their data and test pipelines.

• Actively drive the adoption of new standards and technologies in the physical AI tooling ecosystem.

What We Need to See:

• BS or MS in Computer Science (or equivalent experience).

• 15+ years of professional experience in software engineering with focus on distributed systems and data-intensive applications.

• Proficiency in Go, Python, or Java, and experience operating across the full backend stack.

• Deep experience building high-performance low-latency data systems: binary serialization, efficient data encoding, columnar data formats.

• Strong understanding of distributed systems: concurrency, consistency tradeoffs, latency optimization, and compute-efficient design.

• Ability to identify and fix performance bottlenecks through optimization across the stack, including redesigning protocols and data models.

• Experience designing and implementing workflows across distributed systems.

• Past success building foundational systems that multiple teams depend on, with high reliability and scale.

• Communication skills to be able to translate nuanced system design to both technical and non-technical partners, and talk to users in their language.

• Ability to lead cross-functional projects, influence without authority, and get work done across organizational boundaries.

Ways to Stand Out from the crowd:

• Experience building orchestration or workflow execution systems (e.g., Temporal.io, similar workflow engines)

• Experience working with sensor data pipelines: ROS, MCAP, AV logs, Parquet, Apache Arrow, or similar domain formats

• Understanding of AV & Robotics concepts such as kinematics, control systems, computer vision, motion planning, and/or neural networks

• Experience improving legacy systems through incremental migration, deprecation, and architecture cleanup.

title: AI Safety & Evaluation Specialist - Remote
description:
Job Description: Computational Biology & Bioinformatics Expert (PhD)
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote (Worldwide)
About the Role
We are seeking experienced Computational Biology and Bioinformatics Experts to contribute their scientific expertise to the development and evaluation of next-generation AI systems.
In this role, you will apply your knowledge of computational biology, genomics, and bioinformatics to assess complex scientific workflows, analyze biological datasets, and evaluate AI-generated outputs. Your contributions will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and scientific reasoning capabilities of AI systems.
Key Responsibilities

• Design, evaluate, and critique bioinformatics and computational biology workflows for AI benchmarking initiatives.

• Provide expert insights into genomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic data analysis pipelines.

• Assess and optimize pipeline parameters, software configurations, and statistical methods to ensure accuracy and reproducibility.

• Analyze biological datasets, including NGS, RNA-seq, variant analysis, and protein structure data, and provide actionable recommendations.

• Apply domain expertise to support the development and validation of biology-focused AI models and tools.

• Communicate complex scientific concepts clearly to technical and non-technical collaborators, both verbally and in writing.

• Document research findings, methodologies, and best practices to support knowledge sharing and collaboration.

Required Skills and Qualifications

• PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, or a closely related field, or equivalent industry or research experience.

• Professional written and spoken English proficiency (C1 level or higher).

• Hands-on experience analyzing biological datasets, such as NGS, RNA-seq, and genomic variant data.

• Proficiency in Python and/or R for scientific analysis.

• Experience with standard bioinformatics tools such as BLAST, Samtools, GATK, Bioconductor, or Biopython.

• Experience developing reproducible workflows using tools such as Nextflow or Snakemake.

• Familiarity with Linux and command-line environments.

• Strong statistical, quantitative, and analytical reasoning skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication abilities, with the ability to clearly document and explain technical concepts.

• Demonstrated ability to solve complex scientific problems in specialized biological domains.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with AI/ML-assisted biology workflows or benchmarking initiatives.

• Peer-reviewed publications, patents, or contributions to open-source bioinformatics software.

• Background in single-cell analysis, structural biology, proteomics, or drug discovery.
